notes: A quiet stretch is not a break any more. The middle of a song is often sung softer than its chorus, and the timing read that as an instrumental: it cut the stretch out, so the lines inside it were pushed to the moment it ended and the lines after came late.
That is what put the highlight behind the voice. A sheet the app timed to the song had several lines sitting later than the singing, so the light stayed on a line the voice had already left.

A stretch has to be empty to count as a break now - nothing rising inside it, and almost nothing under the floor either - so a verse sung quietly keeps its own place in the timeline instead of the words skipping over it.
A stretch the recording really has stopped in is still skipped the way it was: the words hold the last line before it and pick up again where the voice returns.
Nothing else moved. The letter wave, the player, a timing you pinned by hand with Line up and the timings already saved on your songs are exactly as they were.
Your home-screen widget and the lyrics you have saved are untouched by this release.
